verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration RESTful API. The Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) covers realms, users, roles and clients, and the docs state those same operations are available over the Admin REST API. The SCIM docs also present the Admin Console and Admin REST API as equivalent management paths. A hands-on community report flags inconsistencies (incomplete GET payloads, POST/update quirks) that make automation harder but do not show missing operations. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of complete UI–API parity, a published OpenAPI spec (probes found none), and a consistent, idempotency-friendly API surface.
